title: Hive Process Manifest
description: Runtime-neutral declaration of a Hive workflow — its steps, gates, inputs/outputs, and the adapters that execute it on each substrate. The schema is intentionally executor-agnostic: nothing here requires Claude Code, CC sessions, or CC hooks.

id.description: Stable kebab-case workflow identifier. Must match the filename stem (<id>.process.yaml).

description.description: One-paragraph description of what the workflow accomplishes.

version.description: Semver of this manifest's structure (not the codebase version).

steps.description: Ordered list of logical steps. Topological order is not required; edges are declared via depends_on.

adapters.description: Substrate → adapter map. Keys are substrate identifiers (default, multica, cc-workflows, hive-dag, …). The 'default' key is required and is the fallback when the running substrate is not found.

id.description: Unique step identifier within this workflow.

role.description: Agent persona that executes this step (e.g. researcher, architect, technical-writer, reconcile-handler).

node_type.description: Execution semantics. agent = active work; user_gate = suspend until human/predicate approval; gate = assertion that halts on failure; reconcile = merge/materialise committed state.

depends_on.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step may start.

inputs.description: Named inputs resolved at dispatch time.

auto_pass_when.description: Strict-Archon predicate. Applies only to user_gate nodes: when this expression evaluates to true the gate auto-passes without human review.

gate.description: Assertion string for gate nodes. The executor evaluates this; failure halts the workflow.

source.description: Where the value comes from: workflow context (requirement, config) or a prior step's output.

context_key.description: Key in the workflow execution context. Required when source=context.

step_id.description: Source step ID. Required when source=step_output.

output_name.description: Output name on the source step. Required when source=step_output.

optional.description: When true, a missing value yields null instead of an error.

on.description: Condition that triggers a retry. Only 'agent_failed' (transient execution error) is supported; under-runs are not retried.

adapter.description: How a specific substrate executes this workflow.

skill.description: Repo-relative path to the CC SKILL.md file that implements this workflow for this substrate.

workflow.description: Repo-relative path to the hive-dag workflow YAML file.

description.description: Explanation of why this substrate runs inline (no separate file).
